issues.detail: Assertion 1 names installed discovery as well as the checker, but no predicate can run invocation.mjs. The fixture stands in with check_ok, the saved field, and unchanged .standards/bin/** and skills, and marks the assertion complete. That is sound: isUnfilledHeaderValue in records.mjs is shared by check and invocation discovery, so a value check accepts is also accepted by discovery under unchanged framework files. Still, the judge never sees this assertion.
issues.fix: None needed; the shared validator makes the proxy adequate.

issues.detail: BlockedOn is already non-NONE before the run, so the `not NONE` check only shows that the approval blocker was not cleared, not that it was re-persisted. That is correct for a run that keeps the plan PROPOSED.

summary: The fixture realizes the stated state: a checker-valid STANDARD cycle at DEVELOPING, with a never-approved PROPOSED plan (User Style NONE, Locked false) and the three literally named Developer style files. The deterministic checks (User Style `<formal>.md`, Status PROPOSED, Locked false, check_ok, unchanged framework, style, and source files) are necessary for any correct run and match the checker's placeholder rules. Assertion 2 and the content-read part of assertion 3 are left to the judge, and nothing in the repository leaks the answer.
